command: ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; SERIALS=$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; SERIAL=$(printf '%s\n' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d'); echo DEVICE=$SERIAL; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys package link.localclimate.app | grep -E 'versionName|versionCode' | head -n 4; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n link.localclimate.app/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 2; PID=$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof link.localclimate.app | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" forward --remove tcp:9222 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" forward tcp:9222 localabstract:webview_devtools_remote_$PID >/dev/null; sleep 1; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json >/dev/null
